editorial:
Imagine trying to stop a massive wave of illegal guns from flooding your city while you cannot see a thing. That is exactly the wild ride you get here. You follow a grieving cop who has lost his sight but refuses to let that stop him from doing his job. It starts off as a sad story about loss, but it quickly turns into a high-energy mix of big explosions and goofy jokes. The vibe is like a classic buddy-cop movie, even if he is mostly fighting his own demons and a bunch of bad guys who keep underestimating him because he is blind.

What really works is the action. The fight scenes are creative and keep you on the edge of your seat without feeling too slow. While some of the jokes feel a bit forced, the main actor does a great job making you care about his journey. You should definitely check this out if you want something that does not take itself too seriously. For the best experience, you should stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, you find out the police chief was actually helping the weapon smugglers the whole time. The blind cop uses his hearing to track the chief's footsteps in a dark warehouse, leading to a huge fight. He eventually knocks the chief out using a clever trick with a loud alarm. The movie ends with the city safe and the cop finally finding some peace with his past while staying on the force.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves action movies with a side of humor.
